J.'''" '''Edgecombe Jr.''' (born July 30, 2005) is a Bahamian [[college basketball]] player for the [[Baylor Bears men's basketball|Baylor Bears]] of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. He was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2024 class. ==Early life and high school== Edgecombe was born and spent his childhood in [[Bimini]], the [[Bahamas]].{{cite web|url=https://nypost.com/2023/11/10/sports/st-johns-hosting-five-star-prospect-vj-edgecombe/|title=Meet VJ Edgecombe, the five-star prospect St. John's is in the hunt for|first=Zach|last=Braziller|work=[[New York Post]]|date=November 10, 2023|access-date=November 13, 2023}}{{cite web |last1=Adderley |first1=Taige |title=Edgecombe Selected to McDonald’s All American Game |url=https://ournews.bs/edgecombe-selected-to-mcdonalds-all-american-game/ |website=Our News |access-date=January 26, 2024 |date=January 24, 2024}} He immigrated to the United States when he was in ninth grade, originally settling in Florida.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/duke/article/vj-edgecombes-journey-from-the-bahamas-has-him-poised-as-a-top-5-player-214067797/|title=VJ Edgecombe's journey from The Bahamas has him close to the top of the 2024 ranks|first=Adam|last=Rowe|website=[[247Sports.com]]|date=August 10, 2023|access-date=November 16, 2023}} Edgecombe attended Victory International Institute in [[West Palm Beach, Florida]] for two years before transferring to [[Long Island Lutheran Middle and High School]] in [[Brookville, New York]] as a boarding student.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/miami/article/5-star-sf-vj-edgecombe-thinks-highly-of-miami-hurricanes-basketb-212507535/|title=5-Star SF VJ Edgecombe thinks highly of Miami|first=Cristopher|last=Stock|website=[[247Sports.com]]|date=July 6, 2023|access-date=November 16, 2023}} He averaged 15.5 points, 5.0 rebounds, 2.3 assists, and 2.2 steals per game during his junior season as the Crusaders won the state championship.{{cite web|url=https://www.fayobserver.com/story/sports/college/acc/2023/10/20/cooper-flagg-duke-basketball-recruiting-blue-devils/71160836007/|title=Cooper Flagg, other Duke basketball recruits visit Blue Devils for Countdown to Craziness|first=Rodd|last=Baxley|work=[[The Fayetteville Observer]]|date=October 20, 2023|access-date=November 13, 2023}}{{cite web|url=https://www.newsday.com/sports/high-school/all-long-island/boys-basketball-first-team-2023-b9enlex6|title=Newsday's All-Long Island boys basketball first team 2023|work=[[Newsday]]|date=April 22, 2023|access-date=November 13, 2023}} Edgecombe was named the New York Gatorade Player of the Year and the National Interscholastic Basketball Conference (NIBC) Player of the Year at the end of the season.{{cite web|url=https://nychoops.rivals.com/news/big-ten-offer-for-luhi-guard|title=Big Ten Offer For LuHi Guard|first=Zach|last=Smart|website=[[Rivals.com]]|date=April 6, 2023|access-date=November 15, 2023}} As a senior, Edgecombe averaged 17.3 points, 6.0 rebounds, 4.0 assists and 2.3 steals per game to lead the Crusaders to a 21-5 record. During his senior year, he was selected to play in the [[2024 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]].{{cite web|url=https://www.thenassauguardian.com/sports/edgecombe-freeman-selected-for-mcdonald-s-all-american-game/article_9287f056-bbd4-11ee-b7fb-7b1d40101376.html|title=Edgecombe, Freeman selected for McDonald's All-American game|work=[[The Nassau Guardian]]|date=January 26, 2023|access-date=January 26, 2023}} ===Recruiting=== According to major recruiting services, Edgecombe was a consensus five-star recruit and one of the top players in the 2024 class.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/duke/article/latest-intel-on-five-star-g-vj-edgecombe-as-final-official-visit-nears-219431227/|title=Latest Intel on Five-Star G VJ Edgecombe as final official visit nears|first=Adam|last=Rowe|website=[[247Sports.com]]|date=November 3, 2023|access-date=November 14, 2023}} He was originally rated 153rd in the composite ranking of ''[[247Sports]]'', but moved up to the top five following his performance in the Adidas 3SSB travel circuit as a junior.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/kentucky/Article/kentucky-basketball-recruiting-john-calipari-vj-edgecombe--221035185/|title=John Calipari, staff visit top-5 prospect VJ Edgecombe|first=Chris|last=Fisher|website=[[247Sports.com]]|date=November 22, 2023|access-date=November 22, 2023}} Edgecombe committed to play college basketball at Baylor after considering offers from Duke and Kentucky.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/39309952/baylor-men-hoops-lands-top-five-senior-vj-edgecombe|title=Baylor men's hoops lands top-five senior V.J. Edgecombe|first1=Jeff|last1=Borzello|first2=Paul|last2=Biancardi|authorlink2=Paul Biancardi|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=January 14, 2024|access-date=January 17, 2024}} {{College athlete recruit start|year=2024}} {{College athlete recruit entry |recruit=VJ Edgecombe |position=[[Shooting guard|SG]] |hometown=[[Brookville, New York]] |highschool=[[Long Island Lutheran High School]] |feet=6 |inches=5 |weight=180 |commitdate=Jan 14, 2024 |scout stars= |rivals stars=5 |247 stars=5 |espn stars=5 |espn grade=96 }} {{College athlete recruit end |scout overall= |rivals overall=4 |247 overall=5 |espn overall=3 |year=2024 |accessdate=February 26, 2025 |bball=yes}} ==National team career== Edgecombe was named to the [[Bahamas men's national basketball team|Bahamas national team]] for the [[2024 FIBA Men's Olympic Qualifying Tournaments – Valencia|2024 Olympic Qualifying Tournament in Valencia]].{{cite web|url=https://therookiewire.usatoday.com/2024/07/02/bahamas-vj-edgecombe-olympic-qualifier-finland/|title=' He has shown serious flashes': VJ Edgecombe dazzles in Bahamas' win over Finland in Olympic qualifier|first=Cody|last=Taylor|website=The Rookie Wire|publisher=[[USA Today]]|date=July 2, 2024|access-date=July 8, 2024}} Edgecombe averaged 16.5 points, 5.5 rebounds, and 3.8 assists in 4 games.{{cite web |title=Valdez Edgecombe Jr |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-olympic-qualifying-tournament-2024-valencia-spain/teams/bahamas/369505-valdez-edgecombe-jr |website=FIBA Olympic Qualifying |publisher=FIBA}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://baylorbears.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/vj-edgecombe/13208 Baylor Bears bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Edgecombe, V.
